# healthchecks_check (Data Source)

Reads an existing check by project ID and check UUID. Configure the provider with the project's read-write `api_key` to read the check without a web session. You can also supply a read-write `project_api_key` on the data source.
## Example Usage

```terraform
data "healthchecks_check" "existing" {
  project_id = var.healthchecks_project_id
  id         = var.healthchecks_check_uuid
}

variable "healthchecks_project_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "healthchecks_check_uuid" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the existing check.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project that owns the check.

### Optional

- `project_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Read-write key for the project. It can be omitted when the provider is configured with the project's API key.

### Read-Only

- `channels` (List of String)
- `desc` (String)
- `grace` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `ping_url` (String, Sensitive)
- `schedule` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `tags` (List of String)
- `timeout` (Number)
- `tz` (String)
- `uuid` (String)
